newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start down, seen confined to tight range.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start down, seen confined to tight range.

text.p: UK shares opened lower on Thursday as a poor finish on Wall Street and continued weakness in world bond markets prompted some early profit-taking.
But dealers do not expect any significant pull-back in the FTSE 100, which has closed at record highs on no less than 16 occasions so far this year -- including six of the previous seven sessions.
"We're just seeing a mirror image of yesterday. The Dow had a bad day so the market makers push prices down a bit but so far there aren't too many sellers," one senior trader said.
The FTSE 100 index opened 13.1 points down to 4,409.4.
